item.title: There’s an AI Market Selloff Everywhere Except Here
item.description: Major tech stocks sank lower last week as AI bubble fears persisted. Companies like Alphabet, Meta and Amazon are forecast to spend $660 billion on AI in 2026. And investors’ jaws dropped. Alongside the stock price…

item.description: Ian understands why crypto investors are nervous right now. But he's concerned they're going to miss out on an incredible buying opportunity.

item.title: How to Avoid the “Boogey Man”
item.description: Every week, I see it happen… Another trader gets wiped out by the same setup. Their entire account: Gone. The worst part is, they never see it coming. And it could happen to anyone who’s unfamiliar with this play.

item.title: Chart of the Week: The AI Race Is Now a Spending Race
item.description: Not long ago, software companies built applications, while infrastructure companies built the rails. Ian says AI is now blurring those lines.
